name: Streaming A Super Agent Based Framework For Reputation Management And Community Formation  E8872A3D5E
text: A Super-Agent-Based Framework for Reputation Management assigns higher-capability super-agents the role of maintaining service-reputation information and sharing it with lower-capability consumer agents inside decentralized systems. This supplies a capability-tiered information-layer design that qualifies Kaal's requirement that reputation repositories and oracles themselves be decentralized. The abstract does not establish how the manager layer avoids concentrated control or manipulation.
